gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-comme: Distinctive Metamorphous leads, loosely spaced, with a soft fat-to-slim stroke. Comme, a plain sans with smooth curves and lowercase bodies that fill most of the letter height, can take a modest size and still read cleanly.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-cossette-texte: Loosely spaced display letters with a high midline and soft stroke swell. Metamorphous swells like pressed glass in each bowl while Cossette Texte, a sans, looks bent from a single wire, and that gap is the appeal.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-fresca: Wide-spaced and stately, Metamorphous carries a high midline and modest weight change. Fresca, a sans-serif with diagonals matching its stems and apertures that keep counters open to outside space, supplies a plain, unmodulated counterweight.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans draws stems and curves at a drafting-pen steadiness, with a lowercase e that opens like a pried clasp. Metamorphous, with its soft swell, supplies the commanding half.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat, its uninterrupted monoline strokes forming words as solid blocks rather than skylines. Beneath Metamorphous, pages of it would settle into a steady hum.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-heebo: Generous sidebearings all around mark Metamorphous, plus a high-set midline. Heebo, a plain sans with a tall central band and curves that stop short of closing, can be sized down comfortably without losing its footing.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-hind-siliguri: Wide-set, high-waisted letters, their rounds carrying a mild, deliberate stress. Metamorphous does the commanding showpiece work, while Hind Siliguri, a plain sans, hums along in flat, constant line weight.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-matangi: Matangi reads like twine pressed flat, with rounded letters left open. Its hefty lowercase can go fairly small, leaving Metamorphous, whose thin strokes weigh about half of the thick ones, to carry the drama.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-michroma: Stately and wide-set: Metamorphous, with a subtle gradient of weight along each curve. And Michroma, a plain sans, gives every letter a wide berth, with stubby ascender tips atop a tall-bodied lowercase.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-miriam-libre: Big sidebearings and a high midline give Metamorphous its stately stance. Miriam Libre, a sans-serif with wire-weight strokes and an s whose spine matches its terminals, would read as one smooth, approachable run across a page.
